facts.text: The Tech Promise covers outstanding mandatory tuition and fees for up to four years for qualifying students with an adjusted gross income of $40,000 or less who receive the HOPE Scholarship and Pell Grant.

sources.title: Undergraduate Admissions - Tennessee Tech Promise
sources.quote: As a last-dollar scholarship, Tech Promise will pay outstanding mandatory tuition and fees that are not met by other scholarships and grants.

sources.title: Undergraduate Admissions - Tennessee Tech Promise
sources.quote: Have a total adjusted gross income of $40,000 or less as determined by the FAFSA

sources.title: Undergraduate Admissions - Tennessee Tech Promise
sources.quote: Receive the Tennessee Educational Lottery HOPE Scholarship and federal Pell Grant
